title: ywec.a: router.rs test-support identity recovery must match AddrForKey or link-local IID
description: Child of project-LICHEN-worker6-ywec (post-AddrForKey IID-correlation sweep). routing/router.rs:695-711 #[cfg(test)] brute-force seed search matches identity.iid == packet_source[8..] - valid only if packet_source is link-local (SHA-512 IID). Fixtures now also use routable upstream addresses (routing/tests.rs:478 ygg_addr_from_pubkey). Fix: predicate must accept identity when ygg_addr_from_pubkey(identity.pubkey) == packet_source OR fe80::+iid_from_pubkey == packet_source; alternatively pass the seed explicitly. Test-only code, no production semantics. Verify cargo test -p lichen-node: compare failure set vs baseline (18 red on main 2026-09-09: 343 passed). Failures not fixed by this slice belong to 5217 (DAO forwarding), cpox (route-lookup install) - do not chase here.
